snippet.title: Evidence Vault | Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Evidence Vault.

Step into the archive division of the Morrow Creek Police Department and bring order to years of forgotten evidence.
Inspect case files, uncover missing information with specialized tools, clean and process documents, develop photographs, label evidence boxes, package completed records and return everything to its correct place in the archive.

What starts as a simple filing job slowly becomes a massive restoration project filled with old cases, mysterious evidence and thousands of records waiting to be organized.

Features
- Inspect and process evidence files
- Use tools such as magnifiers, UV lights and cleaning brushes
- Work with photographs, documents, tapes and evidence bags
- Package, label and organize completed case files
- Upgrade your equipment and archive workflow
- Restore a huge police evidence archive
- Atmospheric retro police department setting

Every file has a number.
Every box has a place.
And the archive is waiting.
Evidence Vault — coming to Steam.

Wishlist the game on Steam and follow the development for more updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5386810/Evidence_Vault/
